stories.headline: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Following Espionage Scandal
stories.summary: Nvidia's board has unanimously voted to reinstate co-founder Jensen Huang as chief executive, less than two weeks after his resignation. Huang had stepped down amid an alleged spy scandal involving a woman suspected of intelligence ties to China. His return followed discussions involving US government officials, including direct contacts by President Donald Trump and White House emissary Vance with the board. The decision drew sharp criticism from US lawmakers and varying international media coverage.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive less than two weeks after his resignation.
